name: c50-api-v1
description: Reference panel for the main ContactBench format (C=50, lookup tools, empty prefix). Opponent Elo is frozen from the published combined C=50 board; an evaluated model's Elo is fitted with these held fixed, so it lands on that board's scale.
anchor_note: Frozen 2026-11-20 from the combined C=50 board (12 low-effort models + 3 max-effort models, 301 fixtures). Provisional: the Fable max vs Carbon max fixture was counted ahead of completion; it does not involve any panel model.
